title: Sebastian and the Debt
author: Emrys Sterling
blurb: Edmund Thornbury, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trade the one secret worth killing for before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
